title: In This World You Can See Who Would Miss You
description: Haruto's number has been zero since he was seven. Then one morning the pigeons waited. Who would miss you? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Haruto: 17-year-old Japanese high-school boy, messy dark blue hair covering one eye, black gakuran uniform, gray scarf
characters.Mr. Tanaka: 78-year-old Japanese man, bald with a thin white mustache, brown flat cap, beige cardigan, wooden cane

scenes.say: In this world, everyone sees a number above your head: how many people would miss you if you vanished. The class idol has 412. Haruto has had zero since he was seven.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Busy school courtyard, glowing numbers float above every student's head. [4-7s] A popular girl surrounded by friends with a bright 412 above her. [7-10s] Close-up of Haruto walking alone, a faint gray 0 above his head.

scenes.say: So he eats lunch alone on the roof. Every morning, he passes the same old man feeding pigeons at the train station. The old man's number is also zero.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Haruto eats from a lunch box alone on a windy school rooftop. [4-7s] Morning train station, Mr. Tanaka in a flat cap throws birdseed to pigeons. [7-10s] Haruto glances at the 0 floating above Mr. Tanaka's cap as he walks past.

scenes.say: But one morning, the old man isn't there. The pigeons wait. Haruto waits too. He asks the station guard, misses school for the first time ever, and walks to the hospital.
scenes.video: [0-4s] The empty spot at the station, pigeons standing in a circle waiting. [4-7s] Haruto talks to an old station guard who points down the street. [7-10s] Haruto walks past his school gate toward a hospital on the hill.

scenes.say: Room 304. Mr. Tanaka lies alone, holding a bag of birdseed he couldn't deliver. Haruto sits down. 'The pigeons got loud,' he says. The old man laughs until he coughs.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Hospital door marked 304 slides open. [4-7s] Mr. Tanaka in a hospital bed holds a small bag of birdseed, surprised. [7-10s] Haruto sits beside the bed; Mr. Tanaka laughs and coughs, both smiling.

scenes.say: So every day after school, Haruto visits. They argue about baseball and feed pigeons from the window. Nobody at school notices. Haruto stops checking his number.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Montage of afternoons: Haruto and Mr. Tanaka watching baseball on a small hospital TV, arguing. [4-7s] They toss birdseed from the hospital window to pigeons below. [7-10s] Haruto laughs, no longer looking up at his own number.

scenes.say: The day Mr. Tanaka goes home, a nurse gasps and points. Above both their heads, the number reads one. In this world, one is enough.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Hospital entrance, Mr. Tanaka walks out with his cane next to Haruto. [4-7s] A nurse gasps and points up at them. [7-10s] Above both heads, a warm glowing 1; they walk toward the station as pigeons fly up around them.
